name: @story/visualizer-client
comment:dependencies: Grepped from the tree, not guessed. `@emotion/react` is the one entry with no direct import: it is the required peer of `@emotion/styled` and of `@mui/material`, so it is declared here rather than relied on through hoisting. The client has no `@story/data` / `@story/core` dependency at all since Visualizer WP8: it never runs the story (the server is its only source of story data, plan §3 "Live refresh"), and `eslint.config.js` rejects a runtime import should one come back. `@story/types` is imported type-only. `@story/visualizer-protocol` is the typed contract with `Visualizer/server`.
